seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in St. Louis Park, MN for 2026: the CPKC Holiday Train on December 14 plus Holiday in Hopkins nearby.
lede: St. Louis Park welcomes the CPKC Holiday Train, and neighboring Hopkins adds a downtown holiday afternoon.
celebrates: St. Louis Park's biggest family moment is the Canadian Pacific Holiday Train, which stops at Lake Street and Library Lane on December 14 with music and a food drive for the St. Louis Park Emergency Program. Neighboring Hopkins holds Holiday in Hopkins on December 5 with photos with Mr. and Mrs. Claus, ornament decorating, a coloring contest and s'mores. A local community group also lists a Holiday Fun with Cindy Lou Who event.
lastyear: The city's page says the Canadian Pacific Holiday Train is returning to St. Louis Park, so it has stopped here before. Hopkins moved Holiday in Hopkins off Small Business Saturday for 2026 to December 5, according to a local real estate blog's report on the event.
facts: CPKC's 2026 Minnesota run has 25 stops according to a local family site, including three in the western Twin Cities on December 14: Golden Valley, St. Louis Park and Minneapolis. The St. Louis Park stop is at Lake Street and Library Lane. Hopkins adds the Elks Lodge tree lighting at 5 pm on December 5.
trains: The CPKC Holiday Train stops in St. Louis Park on Monday, December 14, 2026, with music from 6:15 to 6:45 pm at Lake Street and Library Lane, according to the city. It also stops in Golden Valley at 5 pm and Minneapolis at 8:15 pm. In Minneapolis the Minnesota Streetcar Museum runs the Holly Trolley, and Saint Paul's Twin City Model Railroad Museum hosts Night Trains.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in St. Louis Park for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events across St. Louis Park and Hopkins, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Holiday in Hopkins) through December 14 (Canadian Pacific Holiday Train). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in St. Louis Park

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in St. Louis Park, including 1 from Hopkins
  • 1 free event, the Canadian Pacific Holiday Train on December 14
  • Meet Santa: photos with Mr. and Mrs. Claus at Holiday in Hopkins
  • Parades and tree lightings: Elks Lodge tree lighting at Holiday in Hopkins
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train at Lake Street and Library Lane
